scientific_boundary: EXT-SYS PASS 4 established desk-level ownership separation and a human co-validation architecture. It did not demonstrate empirical cross-layer discriminant or incremental validity. All questions below remain research questions until evidence-bearing EXT-SYS PASS 5 adjudication.

system_result.desk_state: Ten major measurement layers remain distinguishable under current ownership and respondent-operation rules; no desk-stage major-module merge is authorized.
system_result.field_state: Human co-validation execution remains evidence-gated; no synthetic substitution is permitted.
system_result.synthesis_rule: Join after independent measurement; keep source measurements visible; no weighted cross-layer composite.

questions.question_ru: Может ли один и тот же уровень эротической активации сопровождаться разными причинами выбора близости — и наоборот?
questions.question_en: Can the same level of erotic activation coexist with different reasons for choosing intimacy — and vice versa?
questions.current_interpretation: Architecture predicts dissociation between WHAT activates, HOW activation changes over time, and WHY intimacy is chosen.

questions.question_ru: Может ли человек ощущать собственный выбор как внутренне свой, но испытывать трудности с его сообщением и согласованием с другим человеком?
questions.question_en: Can a person experience a choice as internally their own while still having difficulty communicating and negotiating it with another person?
questions.current_interpretation: SELF-SAA and COM-N are intentionally separate ownership territories: internal authorship versus interpersonal negotiation behavior.

questions.question_ru: Может ли уровень эротической инициативы отличаться от субъективного чувства авторства выбора и от причины, по которой человек соглашается на близость?
questions.question_en: Can erotic initiative differ from subjective authorship of choice and from the reason a person agrees to intimacy?
questions.current_interpretation: Initiative/durability dynamics, internal authorship and motive are separate operations; an Agency Total is therefore prohibited.

questions.question_ru: Чем отличается восстановление эротического вовлечения от восстановления разговора — и от более длительного когнитивного carryover после события?
questions.question_en: How does restoration of erotic engagement differ from restoration of communication and from longer downstream cognitive carryover after an event?
questions.current_interpretation: Erotic recovery, conversational repair and downstream cognition have distinct target objects despite overlapping time windows.

questions.question_ru: Насколько communication patterns добавляют самостоятельную информацию после того, как известен attachment/security context?
questions.question_en: How much independent information do communication patterns add after attachment/security context is known?
questions.current_interpretation: Attachment is context/regulation; communication is an interpersonal process. Correlation does not authorize construct collapse.

questions.question_ru: Отличается ли устойчивое ощущение собственной желанности от выбора близости ради получения или восстановления подтверждения этой желанности?
questions.question_en: Is standing appraisal of one's desirability distinct from choosing intimacy to obtain or restore validation of that desirability?
questions.current_interpretation: Baseline self-appraisal, validation-seeking motive and attachment reassurance are separated; MOT validation content remains a challenge territory.

questions.question_ru: Может ли высокая чувствительность к собственным телесным сигналам сосуществовать с выраженным evaluative self-focus или sexual self-consciousness?
questions.question_en: Can high sensitivity to one's embodied signals coexist with strong evaluative self-focus or sexual self-consciousness?
questions.current_interpretation: Own-body processing, stimulus-linked activation/simulation and evaluative self-focus are separate respondent operations.

questions.question_ru: Отличается ли причина использовать близость для изменения состояния от фактически наблюдаемого эмоционального или когнитивного состояния после неё?
questions.question_en: Is choosing intimacy to regulate a state distinct from the emotional or cognitive state actually observed afterward?
questions.current_interpretation: Antecedent motive and downstream outcome are explicitly separated; LIFE does not ask respondents to infer causality.

questions.theme_ru: Эротическая динамика и более широкая жизнь
questions.theme_en: Erotic dynamics and broader life functioning
questions.question_ru: Какие связи существуют между post-event изменениями эротической/relational системы и более широкими состояниями сна, vitality, affect, engagement и meaning?
questions.question_en: How are post-event erotic/relational changes associated with broader sleep, vitality, affect, engagement and meaning states?
questions.current_interpretation: Shared timing does not imply a shared construct; future analysis may test association without causal attribution or target collapse.

questions.question_ru: Как специфические preference/reward coordinates соотносятся с активацией, embodied response, коммуникацией и outcomes после того, как каждый источник измерен независимо?
questions.question_en: How do specific preference/reward coordinates relate to activation, embodied response, communication and outcomes after each source has been measured independently?
questions.current_interpretation: Preference is not activation, bodily response, communication capacity or benefit. RPE detail remains publication-gated; only the join-after-measurement principle is public at this stage.
questions.publication_note: Do not expose detailed RPE construct content until a separate RPE publication authority permits it.
